name: Account Access Removal
summary: Adversaries may interrupt availability of system and network resources by inhibiting access to accounts utilized by legitimate users. Accounts may be deleted, locked, or manipulated (ex: credentials changed) to remove access to accounts.

analytics.name: Analytic 1655
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Account Access Removal by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed.
